sentences.japanese: 君は、彼の申し出を断るべきだった。
sentences.english: You should have refused his offer.

sentences.japanese: 彼の助力を断ったのは間違いだ。
sentences.english: You did wrong to refuse his help.

sentences.japanese: 君が援助を断ったので、事態がややこしくなった。
sentences.english: Your refusal to help complicated matters.

sentences.japanese: 驚いたことに、彼は私の申し出を断った。
sentences.english: To my surprise, he refused my offer.
